t: This compact Titan LED worklight delivers up to 1,200 lumens of cool white light, making it a reliable portable light source for any job. Suitable for trade professionals working in dark loft spaces or under vehicle chassis, the unit features a robust metal and plastic body with one-metre drop impact resistance. A strong magnetic base and adjustable stand allow for convenient hands-free positioning on site. Equipped with 4 x lighting modes, this rechargeable worklight offers up to 6 x hours of runtime from a single charge, ensuring reliable visibility throughout the workday.
